newsitem.title: USA: Banc One has thousands of job openings.
newsitem.headline: Banc One has thousands of job openings.

text.p: Banc One Corp. said Friday it is having trouble finding applicants for thousands of job openings.

"We're aggressively hiring," Banc One spokesman John Russell said in a telephone interview. But he said that the low jobless rate of 2.8 percent in Banc One's headquarters city of Columbus was making it difficult to find new employees.
Russell said the bank was also having difficulty filling jobs in Indianapolis and Milwaukee.
With $97.1 billion in assets, Banc One is the 10th-largest U.S. bank holding company.
Russell said Banc One has a total of 5,000 openings in Columbus, Dayton, Ohio; Milwaukee; Indianapolis; Houston; and Phoenix, which cover a "full range" of job skills.

The company's need for new employees comes as 5,000 positions are being cut. But Russell said new positions are being created, and when the process is completed total employment should remain around 50,000.
Russell said the company hopes to keep all of its current employees, although some will be required to take new assignments.
"It's much more efficient to keep an employee who understands the company than it is to hire a new employee and train them," Russell said.
Part of the need for new people arises from an annual turnover rate of 15 percent, equivalent to about 7,500 jobs.

The "re-engineering" is being conducted through a programme known at the company as "Project One." The bank holding company is consolidating its bank charters in the 12 states where it does businesses into one charter for each state.
In Ohio, for example, 18 bank charters will be consolidated into a single charter. In most of the states where the company does business the process has already been completed.
The jobless rate for the United States as a whole fell to 5.1 percent in August, the lowest since 1989.
